title: OpenAI's agents are chasing ChatGPT slowdowns.
friendlyTitle: OpenAI's helpers are looking for what makes ChatGPT slow.
summary: On 19 November, OpenAI described the Performance Factory, a set of Codex workflows that investigate performance alerts, propose a fix, and check whether speed recovered after deployment. OpenAI says the regression workflow tracked more than 1,700 investigations in a little over three months and found a cause in more than 600.
friendlySummary: On 19 November, OpenAI described the Performance Factory. It is a set of Codex workflows. They look into speed alerts, suggest a fix, and check whether speed came back after the fix is released. OpenAI says this workflow tracked more than 1,700 investigations in a little over three months, and found a cause in more than 600.
whyItMatters: Those counts are OpenAI's, about 17 investigations a day. OpenAI says an engineer still reviews the proposed fix. A slow reply in ChatGPT is not evidence that this system has already repaired it.
